revisions.source: #LIGHT_RED#A carrion worm mass has spawned from %s' wounds!
revisions.target: #LIGHT_RED#一个腐肉虫群从%s的伤口中孵化了出来！

revisions.source: #AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
revisions.target: #AQUAMARINE#当%s倒下时它所有的眼睛都掉落在了地上！

revisions.source: You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...
revisions.target: 你不想知道这个像七鳃鳗一样的恐魔是吃什么才能长这么大的。它的皮肤不停地搏动、扭曲，就像有东西在下面移动一样……

revisions.source: Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.
revisions.target: 这些存在本以为能求得永生，却让不死之身夺走了生之乐趣。现在，他们也试图毁灭生命。

revisions.source: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
revisions.target: 法力蠕虫是以奥术使用者的魔力为食的洛斯格罗斯。如果它们近距离接触到施法者，就会缠上去吸干对方的魔力。

revisions.source: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
revisions.target: 你面前站着一个高大的人影——一个非常高的人形怪物，用本该长着双腿的位置上的粗大蛇尾撑起身体。他的上半身是人形，贴身护甲下肌肉隆起，一双大手紧握锋利的三叉戟。他以阴沉而锐利的目光盯着你，像一头随时要扑向毫无防备猎物的狼。

revisions.source: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
revisions.target: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素生物，被一股强大的魔法从它们的故乡世界带离。

revisions.source: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
revisions.target: 维系这只骷髅身躯的力量足够坚韧，让它像生前一样持盾挥击。它仍穿着原来的旧盔甲，虽已锈迹斑斑，却还堪使用。

revisions.source: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
revisions.target: 这是一个散发着力量气场的类人生物，你注意到它长着一副锋利的门牙。

revisions.source: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
revisions.target: 一只腐蚀性的毒龙幼仔。它独自行动时并不强大，但通常有兄弟姐妹相伴。

revisions.source: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
revisions.target: 腐烂泰坦巨大的石质肢体，一大块石头与腐肉的混合体。你觉得自己举得动它，但它非常沉重。

revisions.source: knock away other creatures within radius %d), dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength) to each
revisions.target: 击退半径 %d 内的其他生物，对每个生物造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 物理伤害（基于力量）。

revisions.source: These blackened boots have lost all vestiges of any former glory they might have had. Now, they are a testament to the corruption of the Deep Bellow, and its power.
revisions.target: 这些熏黑的靴子已经失去昔日的全部荣耀。如今，它们见证着深渊咆哮的腐化及其力量。

revisions.source: #00FF00#The elixir has improved your capacity for exercising your core talents.
revisions.target: #00FF00#药剂提升了你核心技能的能力。
